PHYSICAL EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #16
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: PHYSICAL EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Shot put: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Shot put.
   B. Practise Shot put with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Shot put.
   D. Damage equipment used for Shot put.

2. Best practice when working on Rugby ● Playing Skills ● Kick-off ● Restart ● Ruck ● Maul ● Line-out ● Scrum ● G: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Rugby ● Playing Skills ● Kick-off ● Restart ● Ruck ● Maul ● Line-out ● Scrum ● G with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Rugby ● Playing Skills ● Kick-off ● Restart ● Ruck ● Maul ● Line-out ● Scrum ● G.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Rugby ● Playing Skills ● Kick-off ● Restart ● Ruck ● Maul ● Line-out ● Scrum ● G.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Rugby ● Playing Skills ● Kick-off ● Restart ● Ruck ● Maul ● Line-out ● Scrum ● G.

3. Primary colours are: (1 mark)

   C. Damage equipment used for Environmental Awareness and Ethics ● Waste disposal techniques ● ‘Leave no Trace.

   B. Remove the need for rules
   C. Replace drinking water
   D. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk

10. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. The speed of the music
   B. The ticket price
   C. Only the volume
